_comment: A pinned, unmodified copy of the Learn source pages that hold Microsoft's Logic App definition for Lifecycle Workflows custom task extensions. Never edit these files: update the snapshot by copying a newer upstream commit and regenerating this manifest in a reviewed pull request. scripts/tests/test_third_party_snapshots.py fails when a file stops matching its hash.
name: Learn's Logic App definition and authorization policies for Lifecycle Workflows custom task extensions
license: Code: MIT (LICENSE-CODE). Documentation: the repository's LICENSE. Both copied from the repository root.
not_copied: docs/id-governance/trigger-custom-task.md: the admin center procedure; the chapter links it and uses no code from it.
docs/id-governance/custom-extension-security.md: security guidance; the chapter links it and uses no code from it.

Everything else in MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs. Microsoft publishes no GitHub sample, ARM template or Bicep file for this integration (searched October 30, 2026); the definition exists only inside the configure page, so the page is pinned whole.
